These terms apply to the Check a result add-ins for Microsoft Office (the "add-ins") and the tools and checks on rafikiardhi.earth, provided by RafikiArdhi LLC, Colorado, USA ("RafikiArdhi", "we"). By using them you agree to these terms.

## What the tools do

The add-ins and website tools check the plausibility of results, calculations and equations in research. They are an aid to your own judgement. A check that passes does not prove a result is right, and a check that flags a problem does not prove it is wrong. You remain responsible for your work and for any decisions you make based on it.

## Use

You may use the free version for personal, academic and commercial work. You may not copy, resell or redistribute the add-ins or their code, remove our notices, or use them to break the law. Please cite the add-in as shown in its footer when it contributes to published work.

## Paid versions

When paid versions become available:

Member and contributor discounts are given at our discretion and may be withdrawn if misused.
